ValidationRule.description: Cloud Provider is required when Insight as the primary product line.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(StageName, '3 - Solution Agreed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '4 - Negotiate'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in') ), ISPICKVAL(Cloud_Provider__c , ''), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Insight'), $Profile.Name <> "IME_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin", $Profile.Name <> "IMLA_Custom Sys", $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cloud Provider is required when Primary Product Line is Insight.
